title: Air quality improves after downpour in Klang Valley | The Star
text: Air quality improves after downpour in Klang Valley | The Star × View Nation Air quality improves after downpour in Klang Valley By P. Divakaran Tuesday, 30 Aug 2016 | 4:29 AM MYT share bookmark Related Stories Nation 14h ago Haze worsens with 33 areas nationwide recording unhealthy API readings as of 8am Nation 5h ago Unhealthy API readings recorded across 20 areas as of 4.30pm Nation 1d ago Haze: 31 areas with unhealthy API readings as at 10am PETALING JAYA: The Air Pollutant Index (API) levels in several areas in the Klang Valley have improved following a downpour on Tuesday morning.
